verdict.rationale: Open-source license compliance counseling is a fair question for a law firm with IP and tech-transactions practices, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions open-source licenses, OSS compliance or OSS usage policies as a named capability. The IP & Tech Transactions page refers only to generic 'licensing', which is an adjacent practice and not the named OSS capability the story requires.

support.subject: As a developer, the firm counsels on open-source license compliance and OSS usage policies for product companies, documented as a named capability
